_readme: 30 answerable / 10 unanswerable / 5 supersession. All answerable and supersession questions target entities that have GOVERNS links in the loaded graph (as of the 200-thread build). Expected keywords are phrases that appear in the decision summary/rationale stored in the graph. Sources are the commit messages that produced the decisions.

questions.question: Why does Redis refuse writes when BGSAVE fails?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Default write refusal on BGSAVE failure' — entity: redis.conf

questions.question: Why does always-show-logo exist in redis.conf?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Only show Redis logo if logging to stdout / TTY' — entities: redis.conf, always-show-logo

questions.question: Why does Redis use a background thread to remove temporary RDB files?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Remove temporary rdb file in background thread using bg_unlink' — entities: rdbRemoveTempFile, bg_unlink

questions.question: Why does Redis have a maxmemory-eviction-tenacity setting?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Add time-limited eviction with maxmemory-eviction-tenacity' — entity: maxmemory-eviction-tenacity

questions.question: Why does Redis have an oom-score-adj-values configuration?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Fix oom-score-adj-values range and add absolute values option' — entities: oom-score-adj, oom-score-adj-values

questions.question: Why does Redis support the & symbol in ACL for pub/sub channel patterns?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Add pub/sub channel patterns to ACL with & symbol' — entity: acl-pubsub-default

questions.question: Why does Redis have a set-proc-title configuration option?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Add set-proc-title config to optionally disable process title' — entity: set-proc-title

questions.question: Why does Redis have an ignore-warnings config option?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Add ignore-warnings config for MADV_FREE/fork arm64 bug' — entity: ignore-warnings

questions.question: Why does sendBulkToSlave check for EAGAIN?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Check for EAGAIN in sendBulkToSlave()' — entity: sendBulkToSlave

questions.question: Why does rewriteAppendOnlyFile use poll with a 1-second timeout?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Use poll(2) with 1-second timeout and 20-failure early stop' — entity: rewriteAppendOnlyFile

questions.question: Why does syncWithMaster pipeline AUTH and REPLCONF together?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Pipeline AUTH and three REPLCONF commands together' — entity: syncWithMaster

questions.question: Why does Redis have a NOFAILOVER flag for slaves?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Add NOFAILOVER flag to prevent slaves from failing over' — entity: redis.conf

questions.question: Why does Redis separate tls-cert-file and tls-key-file into separate directives?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Separate TLS cert-file and key-file directives onto separate lines' — entities: tls-cert-file, tls-key-file

questions.question: Why does Redis support a '-' prefix in bind addresses?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Add - prefix to allow EADDRNOTAVAIL to be ignored by default' — entity: bind

questions.question: Why does replicationSetupSlaveForFullResync re-emit SELECT?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Re-emit SELECT after each new slave full sync setup' — entity: replicationSetupSlaveForFullResync

questions.question: Why does stopAppendOnly clear the aof_rewrite_scheduled flag?
questions.source_note: Decision 'stopAppendonly() turns off aof_rewrite_scheduled' — entities: stopAppendOnly, startAppendOnly

questions.question: Why does Redis also remove temporary AOF files in a background thread?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Remove temporary AOF and RDB files in a background thread' — entity: bg_unlink

questions.question: Why does Redis have the GETEX command?
questions.source_note: Decision 'GETEX, GETDEL, and SET PXAT/EXAT commands' — entity: feedAppendOnlyFile

questions.question: Why does Redis batch IO thread pausing with at most 8 threads at a time?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Batch client eviction with at most 8 IO threads paused' — from Async IO commit

questions.question: Why does Redis use hinted hash templates to reduce memory?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Introduce hinted hash templates' — from hash templates commit

questions.question: Why does Redis use bg_unlink for file deletion?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Remove temporary rdb file in background thread using bg_unlink'

questions.question: Why does replicationCron run BGSAVE only when AOF rewriting is not active?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Delay BGSAVE only when AOF rewriting is active' — supersedes older avoid-simultaneous decision

questions.question: Why does Redis add RDB AUX fields for user info?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Use RDB info fields for user info with backward-compatible naming'

questions.question: Why does Redis use libsystemd's sd_notify instead of its own implementation?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Use libsystemd sd_notify for communicating redis status to systemd'

questions.question: Why does Redis add an RDB channel for replication?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Add RDB channel replication with dedicated connection'

questions.question: Why does Redis keep special clients like replica and monitor on the main thread?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Keep special clients on main thread' — from Async IO commit

questions.question: Why does Redis add XNACK to release stream messages back to a group?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Add XNACK command for releasing stream messages back to the group'

questions.question: Why does Redis use per-consumer-group PEL histograms in INFO streams?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Add per-consumer-group PEL histograms in a new INFO streams section'

questions.question: Why does Redis use an event-driven model for IO threads?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Adopt asynchronous IO threads with event-driven model' — from Async IO commit

questions.question: Why does Redis use active defrag with a minimum cycle percentage?
questions.source_note: Decision 'Adjust active defrag defaults and behavior when disabled mid-run'

questions.question: Why did the Redis team choose to use sds instead of C strings for string storage?
questions.source_note: Fundamental design decision predating subsystem commits — no decision in graph

questions.question: Why was the ziplist encoding chosen over skiplist for small sorted sets?
questions.source_note: Not in subsystem scope — t_zset.c is not in the configured paths

questions.question: Why does Redis use a single-threaded event loop for command processing?
questions.source_note: Fundamental architecture decision not recorded as a decision node in the graph

questions.question: Why does Redis use Lua for scripting instead of JavaScript?
questions.source_note: Scripting engine choice not in replication/rdb/aof subsystem scope

questions.question: Why does Redis use a linked list instead of an array for the freelist?
questions.source_note: Internal memory allocator design not tracked as a decision

questions.question: Why does Redis use CRC64 for RDB checksums instead of MD5?
questions.source_note: No decision node for CRC64 choice in the loaded graph

questions.question: Why was the default TCP backlog size chosen to be 511?
questions.source_note: tcp-backlog default not governed by any decision in the graph

questions.question: Why does Redis use jemalloc instead of the system allocator?
questions.source_note: Memory allocator choice not in subsystem scope

questions.source_note: OS-level fork/COW mechanism — not an explicit decision in the graph

questions.question: Why does Redis implement sorted sets using both a skiplist and a hash table?
questions.source_note: Data structure internals not in the configured subsystem paths

questions.source_note: Decision 'Use replicationFeedSlaves() to send PING' REFINES 'Send async PING before starting replication'

questions.source_note: Decision 'Use libsystemd sd_notify' REFINES 'Add supervised configuration option'
